details.question: Why did different students or locations see different IP addresses when pinging google.com?
details.answer: Different students saw different IP addresses when pinging google.com because Google has many servers around the world, and the DNS server returns the IP address of a nearby or less busy Google server. Additionally, reasons for different IP addresses include different geographic locations, different Internet Service Providers (ISPs), server load balancing, and IPv4 versus IPv6 availability.

details.question: Why did changes made using browser DevTools Inspect element disappear after refreshing the page?
details.answer: Changes made using browser DevTools Inspect element disappear after refreshing because you are only editing a temporary copy of the page loaded in your browser's memory (the "rendered DOM"), rather than the actual file sitting on the server.

details.question: What is a REST API and what does an Endpoint represent?
details.answer: A REST API is defined as a request-then-response style of communication, doing one question at a time. An endpoint represents the exact web address that tells the API precisely what data you are asking for.
